text: “You needn’t be so rude, it’s only a ‘lapse of lingy’, as Mr. Davis says,” retorted Amy, finishing Jo with her Latin. “I just wish I had a little of the money Laurie spends on that horse,” she added, as if to herself, yet hoping her sisters would hear. “Why?” asked Meg kindly, for Jo had gone off in another laugh at Amy’s second blunder. “I need it so much. I’m dreadfully in debt, and it won’t be my turn to have the rag money for a month.” “In debt, Amy?
